meta.description: Chicago movers from Better Life Moving: a licensed interstate carrier with crews in Chicago for local apartment moves and moves to other states. Free quote.

overview: Chicago has no shortage of moving companies, and we're one of the newer ones here. What we bring is an interstate carrier's setup: our own crews in Chicago, our own trucks, and crews waiting in Boston, the Carolinas and Los Angeles.
Local moves are billed hourly with the materials inside the rate.
sellingPoints: Moves to and from four other metros

servicesBlock.h2: Moves We Take On in Chicago
servicesBlock.intro: Apartment moves and long distance relocations are where we focus in Chicago, with packing and storage available on either. The full list is below.

whyChoose.h2: What You Get Choosing Us in Chicago

cards.title: Two Ends, One Company
cards.text: Moving between Chicago and Boston, Raleigh, Charlotte or Los Angeles? We have crews in all of them.

cards.title: High-Rise Logistics Sorted
cards.text: Freight elevators and loading docks often need reservations. Send yours and the crew arrives in the window.

cards.title: Wrapping and Truck Costs In
cards.text: Blankets, shrink wrap, tape and truck costs (gas, mileage, tolls) are included in the hourly rate.

cards.title: Public Federal Record
cards.text: You can check our interstate authority, USDOT 3866930, MC 1414489, on the FMCSA website before you book.

faq.q: Are Chicago movers from Better Life Moving a local company?
faq.a: We're an interstate carrier founded in Boston in 2022, with our own crews working in Chicago.

faq.q: How are moves inside Chicago billed?
faq.a: Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added, and a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time. In a high-rise, the elevator wait is usually the biggest variable in the hours.

faq.q: Can you move me from Chicago to Boston?
faq.a: Yes. It's a long distance move, quoted at a flat rate, with our own crews at both ends.

faq.q: My Chicago building needs a freight elevator booking. What should I do?
faq.a: Reserve the elevator for your move window and send us the times. The crew plans the load around that slot.

faq.q: Do you offer storage in Chicago moves?
faq.a: Yes. Storage can be added between pickup and delivery, priced by the cubic feet your items take up.

faqClosing: Need more information? Our FAQ page answers the common booking and billing questions.

closing.body: Send your date and both addresses through the form. A manager will lay out how the move is billed.
